blocks.raw: <WikiMistakeList mistakes={["Treating human settlements development as synonymous with housing production (they are different: one is integrated; one is just construction)","Assuming relocation is always safer than in-situ upgrading (relocation can be more harmful to livelihoods and community cohesion)","Forgetting that livelihood access is a core settlement component (not peripheral; central to survival)","Neglecting disaster risk in settlement planning (climate/seismic hazards now mandatory CLUP components)","Believing CMP is just another housing finance program (it is fundamentally a settlement preservation and community development approach)"]} />
